reviews.review: Initially, this was so different from Left 4 Dead that I didn't like it. Plus some of the characters were a bit annoying and not so endearing. But after reigniting my love and experience for Left 4 Dead, I got curious about this game again. Since I enjoy zombie games I finally gave this one a fair chance, and I must say I really enjoy it a lot. The devs from Valve who made the first Left 4 Dead had a test run on their first zombie games. This is one helluva an improvement. Beautiful graphics brought to us by the gorgeous Unreal 4 engine, aiming down sights, a WIDE array of weapons and items, more than 4 characters to choose from, expansions for the game's story along with DLC characters, lots of options for customization of your character and play style, a card system which gives you buffs for you AND your teammates, your choice of singleplayer with bots or online play with friends or new acquaintances with crossplay options, too, and just pure, non-stop action...are more than enough reasons to really like this game. Need I say more? Get your hands on this game when on sale. The regular price is still too high for the age of this game, which seems to be my only gripe about it.

I like it - the additions to L4D / L4D2 are good.
The campain (which I am only intrested in) plays nice.

This game is just a good old zombie shooter with level progression, its completely fine and the main issues people have with it are that its not left 4 dead which is both fair and unfair as this was touted for so long as long awaited successor. the main drawback with this game is the lack of mod compatibility. If they allowed the community to make custom mods, campaigns, models, sounds, etc like in the original L4D's then this game would still be extremely active. The Card system is interesting and i actually really like that kind of have the ability to kit your character as you see fit for your play style but i can understand why some don't like it, they should just add the ability to let lobby host turn cards on or off and be done with it. Lastly there's no reason this game is still full price, the devs have abandoned it and ended all live service so you should not be paying full price for a game that is no longer being supported

overall its a fun game with a lot of potential, but i cannot recommend it as it's overall shackled by the devs/publishers unwillingness to allow community modding. the devs abandoned it and ended all live service so there is legitimately no reason not to let the small community they have keep the game alive. but i guess letting players be passionate about your game doesn't sell as much as your micro transactions for skins does it?
its good, its not L4D but its good.
